# WeatherConfig

> **File:** `config/WeatherConfig.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Reader for the Weather section: the one location and units every weather widget and module shows (see WeatherManager).

### Properties

- `location` (readonly string)
- `latitude` (readonly string)
- `longitude` (readonly string)
- `units` (readonly string): "celsius" | "fahrenheit"
- `interval` (readonly int): How often it's fetched (ms)
